# Final Review Votes
**Producer:** agent:claude/claude-opus-4-7-max

## Summary

Voted on four amendments concerning the frozenkrill-ugd bead's collapse of the internal Share schema and SuccessEntry verifier fields. Verified the line-count claims (210 ins / 378 del = 168 net reduction vs. 180 required) and verified that the verification_data/verification_data_hi field rewrites at secret_sharing.rs:811-816 are unread by any downstream consumer (complete_vsss_share_identifier, derive_metadata, describe_share_group only read share_data, share_data_hi, original_wallet, share_index, created_at, threshold, total_shares). Accepted three findings (the line-count miss, the dead-code rewrite, and the combined-fix observation that ties them together) and rejected the comment-density observation since it explicitly proposes no fix and identifies no correctness or safety gap.

## Votes

- `fr-2-c6573dbe`: Accept
  Verified: `git diff --numstat feature/pedersen-secret-sharing..HEAD -- frozenkrill-core/src/secret_sharing.rs` reports 210 insertions, 378 deletions = 168-line net reduction. The bead spec at .ralph-burning/prompts/frozenkrill-ugd.md:141-144 explicitly requires at least 180 lines. The structural goals are met but the explicit acceptance metric is not. The shortfall (12 lines) is closeable without touching test coverage by removing the dead-code field rewrite identified in fr-2-cf111a85 plus tightening stale docstrings on the surviving helpers (split_mnemonic, combine_one_half, combine_wallet_candidate_to_mnemonic). The spec is the contract; trimming the dead code path is a clean way to honor it.
- `fr-2-cf111a85`: Accept
  Verified the dead-code claim by reading every downstream consumer of `successes` / `verified_inputs`. complete_vsss_share_identifier (secret_sharing.rs:203-215) reads only share_data and share_data_hi. derive_metadata (secret_sharing.rs:843-918) reads share_data and original_wallet. describe_share_group (secret_sharing.rs:1022-1046) reads share_index, created_at, threshold, total_shares. authenticate consumes only the derived metadata, not the entries. The `w.verification_data = lo_hex.to_string(); w.verification_data_hi = hi_hex_opt.map(...);` writes at lines 813-814 are pure dead-store. Worse, they leave SuccessEntry's wallets carrying verifier strings that are neither the share's own copy nor read anywhere — actively misleading for future readers. Replacing the closure body with a plain `.cloned()` (or .map(|w| w.clone())) is functionally equivalent, removes the dead writes, and improves maintainability.
- `fr-2-aa4d3f78`: Accept
  Same factual observation as fr-2-c6573dbe (168 vs 180 line target) but more nuanced: explicitly notes the ~80 lines of new test scaffolding (split_test_singlesig + the conflict-denominator and lo/hi-splice defense-in-depth tests) are valuable and should not be removed to chase the metric. The proposed combined fix — drop the dead verifier rewrite from fr-2-cf111a85 plus tighten the post-collapse stale docstrings — is a sound path that closes the gap without weakening test coverage or threat-model documentation. The contextual framing strengthens the technical merit of the trim path and is correct on the facts.
- `fr-2-0ca47c71`: Reject
  The amendment author explicitly states 'Not proposing a fix — partial comment trimming was within scope and the bead spec explicitly asked to drop the why-we-carry-these comment in finding 2.' By the amendment's own analysis, code behavior is unchanged, the new defense-in-depth tests exercise the relevant invariants (cross-product enumeration, hi-stripped 24->12 downgrade hardening, winning-verifier vs per-share-copy distinction), and docs/secret_sharing.md still carries the user-facing threat model. There is no correctness, safety, or robustness gap. The maintainability concern (future readers losing inline WHY-rationale at the point of edit) is real but mitigated by the docs and tests, and the amendment proposes no concrete remediation. Accepting an amendment that explicitly disclaims any action item adds no engineering value.
